## About
Pittsburgh Tire is the Pittsburgh location of Good Tire Service. We work out of Smallman Street and handle the everyday tire jobs that keep cars and trucks moving.
We open early on weekdays, so you can come in before work or before a long drive. Our customers have given us a 4.4 rating from 54 Google reviews.

## Services
- New tires: Full sets of new tires for your car or truck, mounted and ready to go.
- Puncture fix: Picked up a nail or a slow leak? We'll fix the puncture and get you moving.
- Tire change: Need to change a tire at the last minute? Bring it in and we'll take care of it.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: We're open Monday through Friday from 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're closed Saturday and Sunday, so plan your visit for a weekday.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: You'll find us at 3301 Smallman St, Pittsburgh, PA 15201.
